title: Item Representations Matter: Bridging Hard Semantic IDs and Soft Prototype Mixtures for Generative Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.05799v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. On the one hand, Semantic IDs (SIDs) give discrete models shared parameters and pretrained semantic structure, but discretizing items into hard codes discards some information from the original content embeddings. On the other hand, continuous models avoid quantization, yet typically use flat item lookup tables with no explicit parameter tying across items. We ask whether a continuous recommender can introduce shared structure without making it a discrete bottleneck. We propose CAP-Mix, a flow recommender that represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector. The assignments, prototypes, and item vectors are trained jointly, and the soft representation is retained at inference. Pretrained information is optional: SID responsibilities can serve as a prior

translated_title: 物品表示至关重要：连接硬语义ID与软原型混合以实现生成式检索
translated_abstract: 现代推荐系统依赖生成式检索技术来预测下一个物品，既可以将其表示为离散编码，也可以表示为连续向量。一方面，语义ID（SIDs）为离散模型提供了共享参数和预训练的语义结构，但将物品离散化为硬编码会丢失原始内容嵌入中的部分信息。另一方面，连续模型避免了量化，但通常使用扁平的物品查找表，物品之间缺乏显式的参数绑定。我们探究连续推荐器能否在不引入离散瓶颈的情况下引入共享结构。我们提出了CAP-Mix，一种流式推荐器，它将每个物品表示为共享原型的软混合再加上一个物品专属向量。分配、原型和物品向量进行联合训练，并在推理时保留软表示。预训练信息是可选的：SID的归属概率可以作为先验。
tldr: 提出CAP-Mix流式推荐器，将每个物品表示为共享原型的软混合加上物品专属向量，在不引入离散瓶颈的前提下结合了硬语义ID的共享结构与连续表示的无损优势。
en_tdlr: CAP-Mix, a flow-based recommender, represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector, bridging hard Semantic IDs and continuous representations without introducing discrete bottlenecks.
